name: PlaywrightSettings

states.name: Page Structure

requiredElements.text: Configure authentication credentials and environment for Playwright test execution.

states.description: The Playwright settings tab renders a SectionHeader with title 'Playwright Tests' and a description about authentication credentials and environment configuration, followed by two card sections ('Test Authentication' and 'Environment'), a Save Settings button row, and an informational 'How it works' box. There are no sub-tabs or nested navigation within this tab.

states.name: Test Authentication Section
states.description: The 'Test Authentication' card contains a description explaining that credentials are passed as PLAYWRIGHT_TEST_USERNAME and PLAYWRIGHT_TEST_PASSWORD environment variables, a Username or Email text input, and a Password input with a show/hide toggle button.
states.precondition: The password input is rendered and contains a value

states.name: Environment Section
states.description: The 'Environment' card contains a Base URL optional text input (passed as PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL) and a 'Skip Web Server Startup' toggle switch (sets SKIP_WEB_SERVER=1 when enabled). The Base URL field has a helper text explaining the fallback to playwright.config.ts. The Skip Web Server toggle defaults to enabled (on).
states.precondition: Playwright settings have never been saved (fresh installation or cleared settings)

states.name: Save Settings Action
states.description: A 'Save Settings' button at the bottom of the form persists all four settings via the save_playwright_settings Tauri IPC command. The button is disabled when no changes have been made (hasChanges=false) or while saving is in progress (isSaving=true). After any field is modified, the button becomes enabled. On successful save, 'Playwright settings saved' is emitted as a success log, and the button returns to the disabled state.
states.precondition: Page has loaded and no field has been modified yet

states.name: Password Security Model
states.description: The password field has special security behavior: the actual password is stored in the OS keychain (Windows Credential Manager, macOS Keychain, Linux Secret Service), never in the plaintext settings.json file. When loading settings, the Rust backend returns '********' in the test_password field if a password is stored. Saving '********' unchanged does not overwrite the real password. Saving null/empty clears the password from the keychain.
states.precondition: Page has loaded after a previous save that included a password

states.name: How It Works Info Box
states.description: An informational box at the bottom of the form (below the Save button) explains how the settings are used at test runtime. It references the process.env variable names and mentions the auth.setup.ts file that reads these variables to log in and save the browser session.

states.name: Settings Load on Mount
states.description: When the Playwright settings tab is first rendered, it automatically calls get_playwright_settings via Tauri IPC to populate the form with previously saved values. This runs asynchronously on mount. If the call fails, an error is logged but the form remains functional with default values.
states.precondition: Settings have been previously saved at least once

states.name: Environment Variable Mapping
states.description: Each of the four settings fields maps to an environment variable that is injected when Playwright tests run. The spec defines this mapping so workflows can verify the correct env vars are documented and the correct fields are present. The UI descriptions on the page itself expose this mapping to the user.

description: Playwright settings tab within the runner Settings panel. Configures authentication credentials and environment variables for Playwright test execution. Contains two card sections: 'Test Authentication' (username/email + password with show/hide toggle) and 'Environment' (base URL + skip web server toggle). Password is stored securely in the OS keychain and displayed as '********' on load. Settings are persisted via Tauri IPC commands (get_playwright_settings / save_playwright_settings). The four settings fields map directly to environment variables passed to Playwright tests: PLAYWRIGHT_TEST_USERNAME, PLAYWRIGHT_TEST_PASSWORD, PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL, and SKIP_WEB_SERVER.
